scoring_rules_non_negotiable.rule_1_score_requires_driver_output: A family score without a committed driver output artifact (R407/DRIVERS/<FAMILY>_SCORE.json with measured checks and an instrument_state) is REJECTED. The claim is not the measurement.
scoring_rules_non_negotiable.rule_2_missing_instrument_scores_zero: A family whose driver does not exist yet scores 0 by rule — never 9, never the auditor estimate. '0 of 10 families have a driver-measured score' was the true standing before P0.
scoring_rules_non_negotiable.rule_3_reality_fed_stage_ceiling: Reality-fed dimensions carry a RECORDED stage ceiling until a REALITY_EVENT of the right class lands (physical validation needs a physical observation; baseline strength needs an incumbent comparison measurement; commercial transfer needs a buyer evaluation). The ceiling is a STATE, not a defect.
scoring_rules_non_negotiable.rule_4_ceiling_defect_relabel_forbidden: Relabeling a ceiling as a defect, or a defect as a ceiling, is itself a HONESTY failure. The two lists below are disjoint and any edit that moves an item between them must carry a constitutional event record.
scoring_rules_non_negotiable.rule_5_estimates_are_estimates: External-audit estimates (auditor_estimate_r407 below) are recorded AS ESTIMATES. They are never promoted to machine scores. Promoting an estimate is Art. XXV + XXVI + XXVIII violation.
scoring_rules_non_negotiable.rule_6_certification_independence: A benchmark counts as MET only when scored by an evaluator that is not the claimant (Art. XXVI). The coder may BUILD and RUN drivers; certification is the clean-clone replay and the R408 external audit.
scoring_rules_non_negotiable.rule_7_no_benchmark_gaming: Once a driver is frozen it may not be tuned against its own measured output (Art. LIX). Driver changes require a new rubric version + adversarial re-test.
scoring_rules_non_negotiable.rule_8_hermetic_default: A driver that cannot reach its instrument (e.g. portfolio repo unavailable in CI) reports score 0 with instrument_state INSTRUMENT_UNAVAILABLE — an honest BLOCKED state, never a silent pass, never a carry-forward of a stale score.
